# 2 Baruch Chapter 74 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**1** "And it shall come to pass at that time that the treasury of manna will again descend from on high, and they will eat of it in those years, because these are they who have come to the consummation of time."

**2** And it came to pass, when I had heard all these things from Ramiel the angel, that I was greatly comforted.

**3** And I said: "Blessed is he who was born in those days, and who is living in that time! For he will see the good things which are prepared for those who love the Lord."

**4** "But I am sorrowful, and I am grieved because of the multitude of troubles which have come upon Israel. O Mighty One, you know what you have prepared for the righteous, and what also you have prepared for the transgressors."

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Paragraph divisions follow the sense units of the source.*
